name: CognitionBioChem: A structural pharmacology workbench that reports a negative result
description: A structural pharmacology workbench for cognition-related CNS targets. Boltz-2 v2.2.1 runs locally and produced every predicted structure; every displayed value carries a provenance record. Nine studies were pre-registered under content hashes before any data was seen, under 27 registered analysis plans. The headline result is negative: designed peptides did not separate from composition-matched shuffles of their own amino acids. A registered positive control on sixteen deposited X-ray peptide-receptor complexes then established that the composition-matched null licenses no verdict on any single case, so that negative is a statement about a batch of designs and not about any one of them; it is also the only study in the slate whose protocol audit records no deviation from its registered plan. Version 1.1.0 is not yet deposited: it has no git tag and no version DOI. The most recent published release is v1.0.0, and the concept DOI resolves to that record until 1.1.0 is published.
